chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Hamdan ibn Suleiman, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fazal and Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Adamy, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Muslimah, from Ziyad ibn Bindar, from Abdullah ibn Sin'an, who said: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said:
There are four things which will cheer you up (illuminate the face): looking at a beautiful face; looking at flowing water; looking at green grass; and anointing the eyes with collyrium at bedtime.
ai.seo_question: What are the four things that illuminate the face according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), framing these four acts as means of *tashrīḥ al-ṣadr* (expansion of the chest) and spiritual refreshment. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the harmony between the physical body and the soul, where sensory appreciation of God’s creation serves as a pathway to inner peace and emotional resilience.
